misconceptions.description: Treating a one-word adopt or reject as a complete adoption recommendation
misconceptions.trigger: learner ends with 'adopt' or 'reject' without scope, conditions, evidence, or reversal signals
misconceptions.feedback: State the scope, the conditions, the evidence behind the call, and what would reverse it. A bare verdict is not a recommendation.

misconceptions.description: Forcing an all-or-nothing adopt or reject when the evidence is mixed
misconceptions.trigger: learner picks full adoption or full rejection despite unresolved evidence
misconceptions.feedback: Match the recommendation to the evidence. Mixed evidence supports a conditional, bounded pilot with a review point, not all-or-nothing.

misconceptions.description: Submitting an AI-written recommendation without taking accountability for its evidence and conditions
misconceptions.trigger: learner adopts an AI 'adopt' paragraph without checking it against the evidence
misconceptions.feedback: You are accountable to students and stakeholders, not the AI. Verify the draft against your evidence and conditions before owning it.

misconceptions.description: Treating a recommendation as final once adopted, with no condition that reopens it
misconceptions.trigger: learner omits the consequence if a stated condition goes unmet
misconceptions.feedback: Build in a trigger: if a stated condition is not met by a set date, the recommendation no longer stands and the tool is paused.
